_description:
Safe-launch preset for Anthropic Claude Code CLI (Bun binary). Recommended: redirect Claude's config out of the real ~/.claude before launching, so the sandbox never needs access to it (it holds session history, memory, and other projects' data, not just this run's config): CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.claude-sandboxed" shadictl --policy policies/presets/claude.json -- claude

If you'd rather share your real Claude Code state into the sandbox instead, drop CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and add: --allow ~/.claude --allow ~/.claude.json

On Windows also add: --allow %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude --allow %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\claude
